purpose: Prove what an ElevenLabs free-tier account CAN and CANNOT do, using the REST API directly (no SDK in the request path), and correct an earlier wrong diagnosis recorded in SUBMISSION.md.

persisted_agent_config.first_message: This call is recorded to protect you…

eleven_v3.message: Free users cannot use library voices via the API. Please upgrade…
eleven_v3.why: Entitlements are enforced server-side by API key. Verified with a bare fetch() with no ElevenLabs client library in the path, so installing the official SDK changes nothing. Only a subscription upgrade unlocks it.

synthesize_any_speech_right_now.observed: both eleven_v3 and eleven_flash_v2 return quota_exceeded (0 credits)

correction.previous_claim: Free tier silently strips tool_ids / knowledge_base / rag from agent create and PATCH (returns 200, fields persist as null).
correction.verdict: WRONG — the blocker was our malformed request, not the tier.
correction.root_cause: knowledge_base[] locators require type + name + id, and `type` must be one of file | url | text | folder. We had sent type='knowledge_base', which returned HTTP 400 (input_invalid on agent.prompt.knowledge_base.0.type), and we then misread the null read-back as entitlement stripping.
correction.methodology_lesson: Never trust a PATCH status code — always GET the fields back. A 200 tells you the request was well-formed, not that it changed anything.

remaining_stage2_gap.tool_call_test: The 9 Agent Testing runs predate tool attachment, so tool_calls=0. Re-running needs character quota. The high-stakes action is proven separately by the 8/8 runtime suite asserting committed:false.
remaining_stage2_gap.eleven_v3: blocked by tier; falls back to eleven_flash_v2
remaining_stage2_gap.spoken_demo: blocked until the character quota resets or the tier is upgraded
